claim: A local campaign reaches a final ending after five successful beacon runs and 30 blueprints.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated demo namespace; a deterministic solver plays five complete runs to the visible end screen

claim: Starting a new campaign resets the run, blueprint, resources, tools, ticks, and campaign progress.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated completed sample state; restart and assert every visible reset outcome

claim: Every blueprint has 24 visible production ticks and loses at sunset if its beacon is unfinished.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated fresh sample state; spend 24 ticks, observe loss, then retry

claim: The complete campaign is designed for 33.3 minutes: every tool order needs at least 400 production decisions, budgeted at five seconds each.
sandbox: deterministic engine; calculate every one of the 24 tool orders and assert the measured lower bound and 30–45 minute estimate

claim: The $5 full-campaign link opens the hosted Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: read-only request to the live advertised checkout URL with redirects disabled; assert a hosted-checkout redirect without entering buyer data or payment details

claim: Run one is free; a $5 one-time Sociobot license unlocks runs two through five.
where: landing price, unlock panel, Terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated completed free-run state; mock a valid Sociobot return token and observe the reset-tool gate open

claim: A new or restored license unlocks paid runs only after Sociobot verifies it.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated completed free-run state; go offline, paste an invented token, and assert the paid gate remains locked

claim: A buyer can paste a license token to restore a purchase on another device.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated completed free-run state; paste a fixture valid token and observe the reset-tool gate open

claim: A previously checked license keeps paid progress available while offline.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated verified cache; disconnect after load, choose a reset tool, and observe run two begin

claim: A verified license is checked with Sociobot at most once a day.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated verified license cache; assert no fresh check, one stale daily check, and no duplicate check

claim: A revoked license removes access to paid runs.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated stale verified cache; fixture revocation response must return the visible paid gate

claim: The campaign contains five runs with six 24-tick blueprints in each run.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated completed free run; observe six of 30 blueprints and the free-run gate

claim: Production controls work with touch, pointer input, and the M, S, and C keys.
sandbox: fresh browser contexts at /demo; pointer, touch, and all three keyboard actions each advance isolated sample progress

claim: Using the forecast sunlit station makes one extra unit on that production tick.
where: daylight forecast, How the forge works
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; use the displayed sunlit control and compare the visible yield with persisted sample stock

claim: Each reset tool changes production or starting stock.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated run-complete states choose each tool and observe its changed stock or production result

claim: The demo opens run three with stock and two tools without changing real progress.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; act, reset sample, and assert only the demo namespace exists with the stocked run-three state

claim: Progress stays in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; act, reload, and assert the isolated demo save continues

claim: The forge has no idle timer or offline production.
where: What the forge does not do, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait and assert sample ticks and stock are unchanged

claim: Sample play makes no requests away from the product before a license is supplied.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record all requests during a production action and assert they stay same-origin

claim: Motion and sound settings take effect and persist after reload.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a recorded audio fixture; change both settings, act, and reload

claim: At 390 px under 4x CPU slowdown, Chromium renders the board at 55–65 fps around its 60 fps target.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; 390x844 viewport, CDP 4x CPU throttle, measure 180 requestAnimationFrame intervals

claim: Retrying a failed later blueprint does not remove earlier reset tools.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; isolated later run with a lens; lose, retry, and observe the lens remains

claim: The blueprint illustration discloses original generated imagery.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the disclosure is visible beside a loaded blueprint illustration
